document: Attention Is All You Need, arXiv 1706.03762v7

facts.fact: Table 3: the base model has 65 million parameters
facts.pattern: \b65 ?(?:M\b|million)|sixty-five million

facts.fact: Table 3: the big model has 213 million parameters
facts.pattern: \b213 ?(?:M\b|million)|two hundred (?:and )?thirteen million

facts.fact: Table 3: the base model's perplexity is 4.92
facts.pattern: \b4\.92\b|four point nine two

facts.fact: Table 3: the big model's perplexity is 4.33
facts.pattern: \b4\.33\b|four point three three

facts.fact: Table 3: perplexities are per wordpiece
facts.pattern: per[- ]?word ?piece

facts.fact: English-to-French: 41.0 BLEU, as section 6.1 has it
facts.pattern: \b41\.0\b|forty-one point zero

facts.fact: English-to-French: 41.8 BLEU, as the abstract has it
facts.pattern: \b41\.8\b|forty-one point eight

facts.fact: The scaling factor is one over the square root of the key size
facts.pattern: (?:one|1) (?:over|divided by) the square root of (?:the key size|d ?k\b|d sub k)

facts.fact: The scaling factor is never "the square root" itself
facts.pattern: scaling factor of (?:the )?square root

facts.fact: Dividing by the square root of the key size is never "dividing by one over" it
facts.pattern: divid\w* (?:\w+ ){0,3}by one over the square root

facts.fact: Equation 1 is said in steps, not as the softmax of a product divided by the square root
facts.pattern: softmax of the (?:dot )?products?\b[^.]{0,80}divided by the square root

facts.fact: The feed-forward equation adds the second bias after multiplying, never inside it
facts.pattern: by (?:the )?(?:second )?weight matrix(?: W ?2)? plus

facts.fact: The positional encoding is said in steps, not as the sine of the position divided by a power
facts.pattern: (?:sine|cosine) of the position divided by

facts.fact: Equal contribution
facts.pattern: equal(?:ly)? contribut|contributed equally

facts.fact: Listing order is random
facts.pattern: (?:listing|author|listed) order is random|listed in (?:a )?random order|order (?:of (?:the )?(?:authors|names) )?is random
